accepted.sentence: A thick pressure hull withstands immense water pressure, while an outer casing streamlines the vessel’s shape.
Floodable ballast tanks fill with water or air to adjust buoyancy and depth.
A stern propeller or enclosed pump-jet provides thrust through the surrounding water.
Retractable optical masts carry cameras and viewing instruments above the waterline.
Hull-mounted sonar transducers transmit sound pulses and detect returning echoes.
Watertight bulkheads divide the interior into compartments, limiting flooding if one section is damaged.
Batteries store electrical energy for quiet propulsion and onboard equipment when engines are not running.
A nuclear reactor heats coolant to generate steam, driving turbines that supply propulsion and electricity.
